info.name: LangFlow Ai - Bug Triage (dynamic)
info.description:
Triages a Jira ticket with Langflow + Groq. The ticket key is the request input: set the `ticket` collection variable to KAN-9, KAN-13, or any key in your project.

Set `apiKey` to a Langflow API key before sending (Langflow > Settings > API Keys). It is blank here so no credential is stored in the repo.

input_type MUST be "chat" - the flow's entry point is a Chat Input node, and "text" silently drops the value.

exec: pm.test("it triaged the ticket, not an HTTP error", function () {
// The flow builds its Jira URL from the chat input. If the ticket key does
// not arrive, the URL becomes /rest/api/3/issue/ - Jira's create endpoint -
// which rejects GET with 405. The model will then dutifully triage that
// error and still return 200, so assert on the content, not the status.
pm.expect(text, "no ticket key reached the flow").to.not.include("405");
